identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of SKB264 Versus Investigator's Choice of Chemotherapy in Subjects With Unresectable Locally Advanced, Relapsed, or Metastatic HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer Who Have Previously Failed Endocrine Therapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Phase III Clinical Study of SKB264 Versus Investigator's Choice of Chemotherapy in Subjects With Unresectable Locally Advanced, Relapsed, or Metastatic Hormone Receptor-positive (HR+)/Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2-negative (HER2-) Breast Cancer Who Have Previously Failed Endocrine Therapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SKB264 in patients with unresectable locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer who have previously failed endocrine therapy.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a randomized, open-label, multicenter phase 3 clinical study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SKB264 monotherapy versus investigator's choice of chemotherapy (ICC) in subjects with unresectable locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer who had failed at least one line of systemic chemotherapy and have not recieved systemic chemotherapy for locally advanced, relapsed, or metastatic stages.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Participants will be randomised in a 1:1 ratio to one of two intervention groups

armGroups.label: Investigator's Choice of Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Nab-paclitaxel, paclitaxel or capecitabine will be administered and managed according to the investigator's clinical judgment, guided by clinical practice.

interventions.name: SKB264
interventions.description: 5mg/kg, IV on Day 1 and Day 15 of each 28 day cycle

interventions.name: Nab-paclitaxel
interventions.description: 100 mg/m\^2, IV, on Days 1, 8, and 15 every 4 weeks

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: 90 mg/m\^2, IV, on Days 1, 8, and 15 every 4 weeks; or 80 mg/m\^2, IV, weekly, every 3 weeks

interventions.name: Capecitabine
interventions.description: 1000-1250 mg/m\^2, orally, Days 1-14, twice daily, every 3 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression Free Survival (PFS) assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
primaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as the time from randomization to the first documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 based on BICR or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS is defined as the time from randomization until the date of death due to any cause
PFS is defined as the time from randomization to the first documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 based on investigator or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.
ORR is defined as the percentage of patients who achieve complete response(CR) or partial response (PR), as assessed by BICR/investigator per RECIST 1.1
DCR is defined as the percentage of patients who achieve CR, PR or stable disease (SD), as assessed by BICR/ investigator per RECIST 1.1

DoR is defined as the time from the date of first documented CR or PR until date of documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1, as assessed by BICR/investigator or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.
TTR is defined as the time from the date of randomization until the first documentation of CR or PR as assessed by BICR/investigator per RECIST 1.1.
Incidence and severity of AEs and SAEs (per CTCAE 5.0), and clinically significant abnormal laboratory findings
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: AEs should be collected from signing the informed consent form (ICF) until 30 days after the last dose

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Mean change from baseline in the European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer Quality of Life Questionnaire Core 30 (EORTC QLQ-C30)
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the impact of SKB264 on disease related symptoms and health related quality of life (HRQoL) in this patient population

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Mean change from baseline in the European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer Quality of Life Questionnaire-Breast Cancer Module 23 (EORTC QLQ-BR23)
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the impact of SKB264 on disease related symptoms and health related quality of life (HRQoL) in this patient population
Immunogenicity test results and titer values of SKB264
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 and Day15 of Cycle 1 (each cycle is 28 days), Day1 of Cycle 3, Cycle 6, and so on (every 3 cycles), up to approximately 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Maximum observed plasma concentration (Cmax) of SKB264-ADC, SKB264-TAB and free KL610023
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of SKB264.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 and Day15 of Cycle 1 (each cycle is 28 days), Day1 of Cycle 3, Cycle 6, and so on (every 3 cycles), up to approximately 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Minimum observed plasma concentration (Cmin) of SKB264-ADC, SKB264-TAB and free KL610023
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of SKB264.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 and Day15 of Cycle 1 (each cycle is 28 days), Day1 of Cycle 3, Cycle 6, and so on (every 3 cycles), up to approximately 24 months
